title: Connection
description: An explicit connection between two components, by named interface, so a child mechanism need not know in advance what it will be mounted on.

parent.description: Id of the parent-side component being connected.

child.description: Id of the child-side component being connected.

parent_interface.description: Name of the interface on the parent component this connection attaches to.

child_interface.description: Name of the interface on the child component this connection attaches to.

transform.description: The relative pose between the parent and child interfaces at this connection.

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this connection.
